why_now: BitMEX announced the exchange closes 2026-09-23 and XBTUSD settles 2026-09-16 12:00 UTC (its own announcement API, read 2026-09-09). The public trade archive already stops at 2025-02-22 and is not guaranteed to outlive the exchange.
resolution: 1-second bars derived from tick data; raw ticks kept only where --keep-raw was used. o/h/l/c/vol/buy_vol/n plus max_size and n_large (trades >= 100000) to retain trade-size texture.
coverage_note: progress.json is the truth about coverage: a date missing from it was never fetched; a date present with absent=true is not published by BitMEX.
